title: Volta: the lab that reminds you
goal: They buy again before the tub runs out.
audience: People who train in Mar del Plata and buy through Instagram and WhatsApp.

post.name: The keyword post
post.msg: One product and one word to comment: WHEY, CREATINA or SHAKER.
post.rule: The Studio makes the post, story and carousel from the same template, with its text and its keyword.
post.alt: Sample post for Ionic Whey with the keyword WHEY

date.name: The sales date
date.msg: «Overclock de precios»: 72 hours with the best sellers, with its banner, its coupon and its waiting room.
date.rule: Every date brings a key visual, a coupon and five products; the big dates open a waiting room.
date.watch: The results of the campaign's coupon
date.alt: Sample cover of the CyberMonday campaign

game.name: The shaker game
game.msg: Shaker Rush: a short game that hands out a SHAKER coupon for the purchase.
game.rule: One coupon a day; the prize can be a sample or the brand's shaker.
game.watch: SHAKER coupons used in the cart
game.alt: Sample game on a phone with the prize SHAKER coupon

wa.name: WhatsApp by status
wa.msg: Twelve messages, one per order status, with the details already in: ready for pickup, shipped, delivered.
wa.rule: The panel writes each message and a person sends it with one tap.

m: Your order is ready for pickup! Drop by the shop during opening hours and say your code.

wa.alt: Sample chat with the ready-for-pickup message

counter.name: The counter
counter.msg: Pickup with a code and sales in the shop, from the same stock as the store.
counter.rule: The batch that expires first goes out first; at closing, the day's expected till.
counter.watch: Counter sales in the day's closing
counter.alt: Sample counter sign for picking up orders

sample.name: The Club's sample
sample.msg: From the Atleta level on, a sample sachet in every order.
sample.rule: Try before buying the tub: the sample travels with the order and is also a prize of the wheel.
sample.watch: Orders of the product that travelled as a sample
sample.alt: Sample sachet of the Volta Club

repurchase.name: The reorder reminder
repurchase.msg: «We reckon your creatine runs out on Thursday. Shall we get another ready?», with the bag already packed.
repurchase.rule: About 5 days before the tub runs out, from each customer's servings per week.

m: We reckon your creatine runs out on Thursday. Shall we get another ready?
I left the bag packed with the same.

repurchase.alt: Sample chat with the reorder reminder and the packed bag

gift.name: The gift, as a story
gift.msg: Whoever receives a gift opens it as an athlete card and shares it in a story.
gift.rule: A 9:16 story drawn in the browser, on a neutral studio, with the product up front.
gift.alt: Sample story with the athlete card of a gift

rules: It talks like a lab: dose, batch and expiry in sight.
One keyword per piece, easy to comment.
Every date has its coupon and an announced end.
next: In production, the messages and reminders go out from the store's server.
source: All of it is in the repo of Volta's demo, with its sample data; the demo's sends land in an outbox.
